hero.headline: Therapy Near Creve Coeur, Missouri
hero.intro: Creve Coeur is a corporate commuter town as much as a residential one — a lot of our clients from the area work at the companies headquartered right there, and their schedules run on meetings, not minutes. We're about 15–18 minutes down I-270, and we keep early, late, and telehealth slots open for exactly that kind of week.

whyLocals.heading: Why Creve Coeur Clients Choose Us
whyLocals.paragraph: Dual-career households are the norm here, and the stress that comes with them — overcommitted calendars, kids shuttled between activities, a drink that's become more routine than it used to be — often gets managed rather than addressed. We work with Creve Coeur professionals and their families on exactly that, before it becomes a bigger problem than it needs to be.

treatmentSection.intro: Here's what treatment looks like, whether you're commuting from a Creve Coeur office or working from home near the lake:

services.name: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
services.description: The most evidence-supported approach for anxiety, depression, and the chronic overload that comes with a demanding job and a full household.

services.name: Family Therapy
services.description: For couples and families navigating conflict, a major transition, or a loved one's substance use.

services.name: Motivational Interviewing
services.description: A collaborative approach for anyone who feels ambivalent about change — common with drinking that's crept up gradually.

services.name: Contingency Management
services.description: A structured, incentive-based approach with strong evidence for substance use, particularly in teens and young adults.

localFaqs.question: Can I fit a session in around a Creve Coeur office job?
localFaqs.answer: Yes. Early-morning, lunch-hour telehealth, and evening appointments are all options — tell us what your week actually looks like and we'll build around it rather than asking you to work around us.

localFaqs.question: Do you see teens from Parkway or other Creve Coeur-area schools?
localFaqs.answer: Yes. We treat teens navigating academic pressure, social stress, and early substance use, often alongside family sessions to get parents and teens working from the same understanding of what's going on.

localFaqs.question: Is your office easy to get to from the Olive Boulevard corridor?
localFaqs.answer: Yes — about 15–18 minutes via I-270 or Olive, with free parking on-site. Telehealth is available for weeks when the drive isn't worth it.
